from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar
def err(w,extra=True):
    cols=[P,P**2,1/P,np.ones_like(t),t*np.sin(w*P)]
    if extra: cols.append(t*np.cos(w*P))
    X=np.array(cols).T
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.mean((X@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt), c
r1=minimize_scalar(lambda w: err(w,False)[0], bounds=(0.5,0.7), method='bounded')
r2=minimize_scalar(lambda w: err(w,True)[0], bounds=(0.5,0.7), method='bounded')
print(r1.x, r1.fun, err(r1.x,False)[1])
print(r2.x, r2.fun, err(r2.x,True)[1])
